title: Isolate container workspace Decapod state from host SQLite WAL
intent: Prevent container workspace Decapod processes from opening the host SQLite WAL store across host/VM shared filesystems. Seed a container-local tmpfs store from a Dactyl online backup and reject unsupported shared mounts before SQLite opens them.
proof_hooks: Decapod validation passes in the dedicated workspace using the container-local data snapshot.
The container launch hint uses the canonical Dactyl online backup and mounts the SQLite store on container-local tmpfs.
Filesystem preflight rejects virtiofs and FUSE before any SQLite connection opens, with actionable WAL-specific guidance.
